main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of short cases, in the short direction
main_measure.threshold: positive with t >= 2 (and supporting check) confirms; negative with t <= -2 rejects; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move at forecast <= -10 minus that at forecast between -2 and -10

decided_by: A confirming t with a failed supporting check is inconclusive.
reading: A case is the first short bet (|forecast| rising >= 2 from its lowest short level since the last bet, reset at flat) in each 5-bar grid cell of a window, judged on close[t+5]/close[t]-1 minus the coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all windows; 'between -2 and -10' is read as -10 < forecast <= -2.
